governance_caveat: Suggestions are welcome but do not directly change any claim's standing. Every contribution is reviewed by the maintainer and only enters governance if and when it is accepted. This keeps the evidence trail auditable.

paths.label: Suggest literature
paths.description: Point to a paper or finding that supports, challenges, or is relevant to a claim or mechanism.

paths.label: Critique an experiment
paths.description: Question the design, interpretation, or pre-registered criteria of a reviewed experiment.

paths.label: Attempt a replication
paths.description: Re-run or independently reproduce a published result and report what you found.

paths.label: Improve documentation
paths.description: Fix an error, ambiguity, or gap in the public docs or this explorer.

paths.label: Help with visualisation / front-end
paths.description: Offer a clearer way to present the claims, evidence, or mechanism map.
